_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for the `klt sim` harness self-test
(issue #275). This is the per-experiment half of the adapter contract:
sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS (ids, the CSV
shape, the snapshot inlining, the Result line CI cross-checks) and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT -- Claim, provenance, corner-matrix prose -- from
a file like this one, so no experiment's narrative is ever generated by
This particular spec documents a SELF-TEST, not evidence: run_probe.sh
feeds it to the adapter against a scratch experiment directory under
/tmp and nothing it produces is committed. A real experiment keeps its
own spec beside its request under sim/<exp>/testbench/.
Experiment: harness self-test for `klt sim` (issue #275) -- NOT committed evidence
Claim: No claim. This record exists only to prove sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py emits a record/CSV/log/snapshot quadruple that .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py's own record checks accept, and whose netlist snapshot inlines the DUT's devices so the D2 freshness rule can see them. The simulated point is a one-corner reproduction of sim/core-open-loop-bias's committed typ/27C/3.30V row, used as a numerical anchor on the harness, not as a new measurement.
Netlist provenance: `design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice` -- the trim-bearing schematic core at the ratified default `trim_code=128` (issue #264). The `.subckt bandgap_trim` block is spliced out of that file by `run_probe.sh` at run time rather than copied, so the probe's DUT provenance is the committed netlist by construction.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in `sim/pdk.json`; OSDI models built by `sim/tools/build-osdi.sh`.
Corner matrix run: process {typ} x temperature {27} C x supply {3.30} V (one corner -- a debug probe, deliberately)
